# AURJA

> AURJA is a Surat-based jewelry atelier creating fine jewelry shaped for stories.

## About

- [Our story](https://aurja.co.in/story): The values and inspiration behind AURJA.
- [Shop jewelry](https://aurja.co.in/products): Browse the AURJA jewelry collection.
- [Blogs](https://aurja.co.in/blogs): Read stories and jewelry guides.
- [Care guide](https://aurja.co.in/care-guide): Learn how to care for your jewelry.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://aurja.co.in/faq): Answers to common customer questions.
- [Custom design](https://aurja.co.in/custom-design): Information about custom jewelry.
- [Sitemap](https://aurja.co.in/sitemap.xml): Discover public pages on the site.
